summary: Two-stage virtual dispatch: calls vtable slot at +0x18 on this; if the result is non-null, calls vtable slot at byte offset +28 on that result and returns it, otherwise returns the null result. Structural twin of sub_404D20 (00404d20); subsystem 'ai'.

local_names.result: first dispatch return value, reused as second dispatch object

operations.description: result = (this->vtable[0x18])(this) — first virtual call, slot at +0x18.
return (result->vtable[28])(result) — second virtual call, slot at byte offset +28 on the returned object.
return result — null when the first dispatch returned null (chain short-circuits).

unresolved: Second dispatch reads vtable slot at byte offset +28; only the first slot (+0x18) has a dedicated field evidence entry in the packet.
